'''Reflection''' is a [[skill]] granted by {{il|The Saviour}}.

==Mechanics==
'''Reflection''' is triggered when you deal a [[critical strike]] using a non-[[vaal skill|Vaal]] [[attack]] skill using The Saviour.

Dual wielding {{il|The Saviour}} does not increase the maximum number of Mirage Saviours; it will instead spawn independent Mirage Saviours, though the cap is shared between them.

The duration of Mirage Saviours can be modified by support gems socketed in The Saviour, as well as other modifiers to skill effect duration.

Mirage Saviours are a type of [[proxy]], and use the [[character]]'s offensive stats. This also means a Mirage Saviour will update its stats dynamically, such as if a character gained or lost a buff relevant to the skill's calculations. Mirage Savious do not possess copies of your [[aura]] effects, though they are affected by the stats from your auras affecting you. Mirage Saviours are not [[minion]]s and do not scale with minion modifiers.

{{il|Multistrike Support}}, due to causing repeats, may help the Mirage Saviours with remaining in range of an enemy rather than frequently reposition due to their mobile nature.

==Skill functions and interactions==
Toggling [[Stance|Blood/Sand Stance]] causes Blood/Sand skills used by Mirage Saviours to change immediately.

Mirage Saviours cannot use skills from other proxies such as {{il|Blade Trap}} or skills supported by {{il|General's Cry}}, and cannot use {{il|Crushing Fist}} or other [[retaliation]] skills.

Mirage Saviours are able to have charges (such as gaining Endurance Charges from {{il|Replica Victario's Charity}}) and use them for skill effects, but do not benefit from charge bonuses (as the skills would care about the character's charges instead).

The following are other observations or interactions with skills noted by users:

* {{il|Blade Flurry}} and {{il|Charged Dash}} - Mirage Saviours do not seem to release the channeling very often
* {{il|Consecrated Path}} - Works as expected. Particularly mobile due to skill's inherent teleporting
* {{il|Cyclone}} - Works as expected. Particularly mobile due to skill allowing attacking while moving
* {{il|Dominating Blow}} - Minion caps are shared globally regardless of whether the player or Mirage Saviours kill the enemy
* {{il|Flicker Strike}} - Cooldown still applies for Mirage Saviours and they can use their own frenzy charges to bypass cooldown
* {{il|Infernal Blow}} - Mirage Savious can cause explosions by themselves
* {{il|Rage Vortex}} and {{il|Rage Vortex of Berserking}} - Mirage Saviour appears to only use the skill as if they have no rage, causing them to only spin once instead of creating a ragestorm or attaching itself to them.
* {{il|Vigilant Strike}} - Cooldown still applies for Mirage Saviours and they can use their own endurance charges to bypass cooldown

{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* The Saviour: '''Mirage Warriors''' have been renamed '''Mirage Saviours''', to differentiate them from those created by {{il|General's Cry}}. [[Strike]] skills used by Mirage Saviours cannot hit additional targets. This affects all existing versions of the item.

''This change is required to maintain server performance, as builds using The Saviour with certain Strike skills were causing enough calculations to put noticeable strain on the servers. It was accidentally missed in the Development Manifesto. ''
}}
{{Version history table row|3.10.0|

These '''Mirage Warriors''' now have a cool new effect.
